english.note: Use this only for a traditional covered veranda or street-level arcade, rather than an ordinary projecting balcony.

examples.english: When it rains, everyone shelters from the rain under the balcony.
examples.traditional: 落雨嗰陣，大家喺騎樓底避雨。
